faq.v1Q: Can I sell gaming top-ups (Free Fire, Robux, PUBG)?
faq.v1A: Absolutely! TEKÇA is built for digital content sellers. You can sell Free Fire diamonds, Robux, passes or gift cards. Delivering player IDs or codes is smooth and fast.
faq.v2Q: How is my payment guaranteed when I deliver a top-up or digital code?
faq.v2A: Thanks to our escrow system, the buyer deposits the money before you process the top-up. Once delivery is done and confirmed, your funds are automatically released to your seller balance. Zero risk of handing out diamonds without getting paid.
faq.v3Q: How do I withdraw my sales earnings to Mobile Money?
faq.v3A: It's instant. From your seller dashboard, you request a withdrawal to your Mobile Money (MTN, Airtel, etc.), confirm it with your secret PIN, and the money lands directly on your phone.
faq.v4Q: Why isn't communication done through WhatsApp?
faq.v4A: On WhatsApp, there's no protection against scams. TEKÇA's encrypted internal messaging is directly linked to the escrow system to protect both buyer and seller in case of a dispute.
faq.v5Q: Could my account or balance get hacked?
faq.v5A: No. Every withdrawal request requires your secret PIN, and our system includes an anti-brute-force security log that blocks any suspicious attempt.
faq.v6Q: Do I need administrative paperwork (business registration) to sell?
faq.v6A: No paperwork is required. You sign up for free and can start selling your top-ups or items right away.
faq.r1Q: How do I contact a seller?
faq.r1A: Always use TEKÇA's built-in messaging. Giving out a direct phone number or moving the conversation to WhatsApp or any other app is not allowed. This way, every exchange stays recorded on the platform and can serve as evidence in case of a dispute.
faq.r2Q: Why is it important to rate a seller?
faq.r2A: Once your order is delivered, you can rate the seller and leave a review with the “Leave a review” button. Ratings ensure transparency between members, reward good sellers and reassure the whole community before every purchase.
faq.s1Q: How do I contact TEKÇA customer support?
faq.s1A:
You can contact TEKÇA support at any time from the app: open My account, Support section, then “Contact us”, or write to support@tekca.com. You can also ask the AI assistant using the floating “Need help?” button.
Our team is available 7 days a week to answer your questions, guide you through procedures (KYC, creating listings, subscriptions) or handle your bug reports.
faq.s2Q: What should I do if there is a problem or a dispute with an order?
faq.s2A:
If you have a disagreement with a seller or a buyer (non-conforming product, late delivery, refusal to fulfil the order), never start a procedure outside the platform.
Open My account, Support section, then “Contact us”, choose the reason “Dispute with a seller” and describe the situation. You then follow the reply in “My complaints”. Thanks to our escrow payment system, the funds stay blocked in a neutral way. The TEKÇA team reviews the evidence provided in the built-in messaging and decides within 24 to 48 hours whether to refund the buyer or release the funds to the seller.
faq.i1Q: Which products and services are strictly PROHIBITED on TEKÇA?
faq.i1A:
To keep the community safe and comply with the laws in force in the 20 countries we serve, TEKÇA applies a zero-tolerance policy. The following are strictly prohibited from being posted, sold or searched for:
• Illegal substances: drugs, narcotics, prescription medicines, dangerous chemicals.
• Weapons & security: firearms, ammunition, bladed weapons, military or law-enforcement equipment.
• Official documents & forgeries: passports, national ID cards, driving licences, diplomas, counterfeit banknotes or fake administrative documents.
• Counterfeits & piracy: imitation products of registered brands, pirated software, stolen accounts.
• Sensitive content: pornographic or explicit material, or content inciting violence and hatred.
• Illegal financial activities: pyramid schemes, money laundering, usurious or unregulated loan offers.
faq.i2Q: What is the user's responsibility and what are the penalties for fraud?
faq.i2A:
TEKÇA acts solely as a technology platform and neutral intermediary. Each seller is legally and criminally responsible for the items they put online.
In case of attempted fraud, sale of prohibited products or identity theft:
• The listing is removed immediately.
• The user's account is permanently banned without notice.
• Funds pending in the wallet may be frozen.
• TEKÇA reserves the right to pass identification data (KYC, IP address, phone numbers) to the competent judicial authorities.
faq.e1Q: What are the rules for posting job offers and services?
faq.e1A: To protect job seekers from scams and undeclared work, posting job offers and recruitment ads on TEKÇA is strictly regulated. Only companies or recruiters who have completed Pro KYC verification (ID, trade register number or official approval) may post offers. All ads go through prior moderation before going online.
faq.e2Q: Is it allowed to charge application or processing fees to candidates?
faq.e2A:
It is strictly PROHIBITED. On TEKÇA, no recruiter, agency or individual may ask a candidate for money (application fees, CV processing fees, interview deposit or purchase of an outfit).
Any report of a request for money under the pretext of a job will lead to the immediate and permanent ban of the recruiter account, with no subscription refund, as well as legal action for attempted fraud.
faq.t1Q: What fees does TEKÇA charge on sales?
faq.t1A:
TEKÇA applies a 100% transparent pricing policy. The commission charged on each successful sale depends on your subscription tier:
• Free: 0 FCFA, up to 10 products, 10% commission.
• Basic: 2,500 FCFA/month, 50 products, Verified Seller badge, 7% commission.
• Pro: 6,000 FCFA/month, 200 products, priority promotion, access to flash sales 12 h before everyone else, 4% commission.
• Premium: 15,000 FCFA/month, unlimited products, Top promotion, disputes handled with priority (2 h), 3% cashback on your purchases, 1% commission.
Discounted rates are available for 3, 6 or 12-month subscriptions. Transfer fees between accounts also drop with the tier: 7% (Free), 5% (Basic), 3% (Pro) and 1% (Premium).
faq.t2Q: Why are there small fees when withdrawing to Mobile Money?
faq.t2A: When you withdraw your TEKÇA balance to your Mobile Money account (MTN, Airtel, Orange Money, etc.), small technical fees may apply. These fees are not revenue for TEKÇA: they correspond directly to the transfer rates applied by the telecom operators and local partner payment aggregators to secure and carry out the transfer.
faq.l1Q: What safety rules are mandatory for an in-person handover?
faq.l1A:
If you choose physical delivery or an in-person handover, the safety of our users is the top priority. TEKÇA requires you to follow these rules:
• Public places only: always arrange the meeting in a public, busy and well-lit place (petrol station, shopping centre, café, in front of a bank branch or a police station).
• Avoid isolated or private places: never agree to meet in dark alleys, isolated areas or at a stranger's home (except for a specific logistical constraint such as heavy furniture, and with other people present).
• Bring someone with you: always come to the meeting accompanied by a relative or friend.
• Inspect before validating: the buyer must take the time to test and carefully inspect the item before confirming delivery in the app.
faq.l2Q: How should payment be handled for an in-person handover?
faq.l2A:
Never handle large amounts of cash at a meeting.
Payment must be made through TEKÇA's secure system. The buyer pays in the app, the money is held in escrow, and only once the item has been inspected and handed over in person does the buyer confirm receipt on their phone to release the funds to the seller. Any seller or buyer who demands cash payment outside the platform risks having their account suspended.
faq.t3Q: Why does the payment recipient show a partner number?
faq.t3A: TEKÇA uses banking infrastructure and a certified aggregator to secure your deposits and withdrawals. The number or name shown when you validate the Mobile Money payment is the official merchant account, held in escrow, of our financial partner.

nature.p1: TEKÇA is a marketplace connecting independent third-party sellers with buyers. TEKÇA is not itself the seller of the products offered by sellers on the platform, unless explicitly stated otherwise on a product page. Each seller remains solely responsible for the accuracy of their listings, the compliance of the products sold, and adherence to their legal obligations.
nature.p2: Each seller is solely responsible for ensuring their activity complies with the laws of their country. TEKÇA does not require any administrative documents (business registration, tax ID, or equivalent) to create a seller account or start selling on the platform.

propriete.p1: The TEKÇA brand, logo, visual identity, and technical elements of the platform are the property of TEKÇA or its partners. Any unauthorized reproduction is prohibited.
propriete.p2: Content published by sellers (photos, product descriptions) remains their property; by publishing it on TEKÇA, they grant the platform the right to display it as part of the normal operation of the service.

responsabilite.p1: TEKÇA makes every effort to ensure the availability and accuracy of the information on the site, without guarantee of results. TEKÇA cannot be held liable for damages resulting from the use of the site, a service interruption, or a dispute between a buyer and a third-party seller, subject to applicable mandatory legal obligations.

objet.p1: These Terms of Service and Sale ("Terms") govern access to and use of the TEKÇA platform, a marketplace connecting sellers and buyers for the purchase of gaming products, digital top-ups, streaming subscriptions, and related services (events, training, AI assistant).
objet.p2: Use of TEKÇA implies full and unconditional acceptance of these Terms.

age.p1: Registration is reserved for individuals at least 14 years of age. Between the ages of 14 and 16, registration must be carried out with the authorization of a legal guardian.
age.p2: For any purchase of a physical good via The Market by a user aged 14 to 16, the seller agrees to deliver directly to the minor's home address (as declared by the minor) rather than arranging an alternative in-person handoff location. This rule does not apply to users aged 17 and above.
age.p3: Each user is responsible for the confidentiality of their credentials and for any activity carried out from their account.
age.p4: TEKÇA reserves the right to suspend or close an account in the event of suspected fraud, failure to comply with these Terms, or at the request of a competent authority.

vendeurs.p1: Any seller wishing to offer products on TEKÇA must create a seller account, subject to approval by the TEKÇA team. The seller remains solely responsible for the compliance, description, and availability of their products, as well as for complying with the regulations applicable to their activity.
vendeurs.p2: TEKÇA reserves the right to refuse, suspend, or remove a listing or seller account that does not comply with these terms, particularly in the event of prohibited or counterfeit products, or misleading commercial practices.

paiement.titre: Nature of Payment Services and Virtual Wallet
paiement.p1: Role of technical intermediary: TEKÇA acts exclusively as a technical intermediary and matchmaking marketplace. TEKÇA is neither a bank, nor a payment institution, nor an issuer of electronic money within the meaning of CEMAC / COBAC regulations.
paiement.p2: Exclusive payment aggregator: all financial operations — top-ups (MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money, bank cards, etc.), collections, temporary escrow, and fund withdrawals — are executed and managed exclusively by our payment partner, Sebpay (or any other partner institution designated at a later date). No user funds are collected or held on TEKÇA's own servers or accounts: amounts paid are deposited, secured, and held directly in TEKÇA's official merchant account with Sebpay.
paiement.p3: Balance display ("wallet"): the balance shown in the user's area of the platform is a visual and accounting representation of the credits available with the partner payment provider, reflecting in real time the funds available and secured in the central merchant account managed by Sebpay. It does not constitute a bank deposit or an electronic money account held by TEKÇA.
paiement.p4: Traceability: all top-up, transfer, and settlement operations are carried out via Sebpay's secure APIs and recorded in an immutable history.
paiement.p5: Execution mandate: by carrying out a transaction on the platform (purchase, transfer to another user, withdrawal), the user grants TEKÇA a mandate to transmit to Sebpay the corresponding execution, temporary hold (escrow), or fund transfer instructions.

commande.p1: Payments on TEKÇA are made via Airtel Money, MTN Mobile Money, GIMACPAY, or Sebpay depending on the user's geographic area. The amount charged corresponds to the price displayed at the time of the order.
commande.p2: The user is solely responsible for the accuracy of the phone number or identifier entered during top-up or withdrawal operations via Sebpay. TEKÇA cannot be held liable for delays or execution errors attributable to the telecom operator or the third-party payment network.

sequestre.p1: For orders of physical products or accounts/services involving a third-party seller, funds paid by the buyer are placed in temporary escrow with Sebpay until confirmation of successful delivery, after which TEKÇA instructs Sebpay to release the funds to the seller (less any applicable service commission).
sequestre.p2: During a transaction between members (purchase of an account, in-game currency, or items), TEKÇA acts as a technical arbitrating third party: funds remain secured in the partner merchant account until delivery is confirmed by the buyer, or until validated by support within 24 to 48 hours in the event of a dispute. Once funds are released to the seller, the transaction is irreversible.
sequestre.p3: In the event of a dispute (product not received, not as described, or other disagreement), the buyer or seller may contact TEKÇA support via the Contact page; TEKÇA may then suspend the transmission of new transfer or withdrawal instructions concerning the seller's account in question while the matter is under review.

disponibilite.p1: 1. Dynamic nature of the platform and bug reporting. The TEKÇA platform is a dynamic digital service under constant development. While we make every effort to ensure maximum availability and an optimal experience, TEKÇA does not guarantee that the site or application will be entirely free of errors, bugs, slowdowns, or temporary interruptions.
disponibilite.p2: The user acknowledges that technical malfunctions may occur. In the event of a bug, display error, or anomaly on the service, the user agrees not to exploit the flaw and to immediately contact TEKÇA technical support at support@tekca.com (or via the dedicated support area) so that our teams can intervene and resolve the problem as quickly as possible. TEKÇA cannot be held liable for direct or indirect damages resulting from such temporary technical interruptions.
disponibilite.p3: 2. Third-party payment services (SebPay aggregator). All financial transactions, pro subscription payments, listing fees, and option purchases on the TEKÇA platform are executed and secured via our payment aggregation partner, SebPay.
disponibilite.p4: Disclaimer: TEKÇA does not store any banking data or direct payment method on its own servers.
disponibilite.p5: Payment incidents: in the event of a failed transaction, double charge, delay in payment validation, or card/Mobile Money rejection originating from the SebPay network or telecom operators, TEKÇA's liability cannot be engaged.
disponibilite.p6: Claims: in the event of a payment-related anomaly, the user must inform TEKÇA support, providing their transaction reference, so that our teams can liaise with the SebPay aggregator.

retractation.p1: Return and refund conditions may vary depending on the nature of the product (a physical good is not treated the same way as a digital top-up or an already-activated subscription, which are generally non-refundable once delivered). Product-specific conditions are stated on the product page or communicated by the seller.

interdits.p1: The following are prohibited on TEKÇA: the sale of illegal or counterfeit products, bypassing the wallet/escrow system for off-platform transactions, harassment of other users, and any attempt at payment fraud or identity theft.

litiges.p1: TEKÇA acts as a technical intermediary between buyers and sellers and cannot be held liable for a third-party seller's failure to meet their own obligations, subject to applicable mandatory legal provisions.
litiges.p2: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Congo. Failing an amicable resolution, any dispute shall be brought before the competent courts of the Republic of Congo.

modification.p1: TEKÇA may amend these Terms at any time; users will be informed of any substantial changes. Continued use of the platform after a change constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

collecte.p1: TEKÇA collects the data you provide directly: name, email, phone number, and, for identity verification related to the wallet, an identity document and associated information.
collecte.p2: Data related to use of the service is also automatically collected: order history, wallet transactions, messages exchanged with a seller or support, and technical connection information (IP address, in particular for protection against fraudulent login attempts).

utilisation.p1: This data is used to: create and secure your account, process your orders and payments, prevent fraud (limiting login attempts, identity verification beyond certain withdrawal thresholds), provide customer support, and improve the service.
utilisation.p2: If you use the AI assistant built into TEKÇA, the content of your conversations with the assistant is transmitted to our artificial intelligence provider to generate a response, under the conditions described below.

partage.p1: Your data is never sold. It may be shared with: our technical providers (encrypted cloud infrastructure for hosting data and the application), our payment providers (Sebpay, and the relevant mobile money operators) strictly to the extent necessary to process a payment, and our artificial intelligence provider for the operation of the AI assistant.
partage.p2: These providers may host or process data outside the Republic of Congo. We only work with providers offering appropriate security guarantees.

securite.p1: Access to data is protected by database-level security rules (each user can only read their own data), by encryption of communications, and by a system limiting login attempts. Passwords are hashed and are never stored or viewable in plain text, including by our own team.

conservation.p1: Data is retained for as long as necessary to provide the service and to meet our legal obligations (in particular accounting and anti-fraud obligations). Identity documents provided for wallet verification are retained for the periods required by our fraud-prevention obligations, then deleted.

droits.p1: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us via the Contact page. Some data (transaction history in particular) may need to be retained despite a deletion request, in order to meet our legal obligations.

cookies.p1: TEKÇA uses technical cookies necessary for the site to function (maintaining your login session). No third-party advertising cookies are used at this stage.

mineurs.p1: TEKÇA is accessible from age 14. Between the ages of 14 and 16, account creation requires the authorization of a legal guardian, and any purchase of a physical good must be delivered directly to the minor's home by the seller, without an in-person handoff at another location. If we become aware that an account belonging to someone under 14 has been created, or that an account for someone aged 14-16 was created without a legal guardian's authorization, that account may be suspended.

contact.p1: For any question regarding this policy or your personal data: support@tekca.com.

numerique.texte: Delivery is automatic and immediate as soon as payment is confirmed. No confirmation code is required for this type of product.

physique.texte: The amount paid is set aside (escrow) and is only paid to the seller after delivery is confirmed. When you place your order, you receive a 6-character code (letters and numbers): give it to the seller only when you receive the product in person. This code triggers payment to the seller — never share it before you have the product in hand.

delais.texte: In-person handoff timing is to be arranged directly with the seller via the platform's messaging. TEKÇA does not handle physical transport of the product.

litiges.texte: If the product received does not match its description, do not give out the confirmation code and immediately report the issue via "Contact Us", specifying the order in question. The seller's wallet is automatically frozen while the team reviews the situation.

remboursement.texte: As long as the confirmation code has not been shared, the money remains in escrow and has not been paid to the seller — a refund to the buyer remains possible in the event of a dispute confirmed by the team.
